# `prefer-optional-while-capture`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports `while (true)` loops whose first statement unwraps an optional with
`orelse break`.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Capturing the optional in the `while` condition states both iteration and
exhaustion in one place.

## When it fires

The declaration must be the first loop statement and use an unlabeled, valueless
break. Labeled exits and setup before iteration are excluded.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn next() ?u32 {
    return null;
}

fn run() void {
    while (true) {
        const v = next() orelse break;
        _ = v;
    }
}
```
